staff_office_rota.title: Duty-sheet master
staff_office_rota.speaker: protagonist
staff_office_rota.text: The binder lies open to an unused duty sheet. Two rings hold the left margin; beside it, a carbon sheet carries the same layout. Several boxes are stamped, but none has a name in it.
staff_office_rota.repeat_text: The boxes are stamped. The names have not been entered.

record.text: An office binder holds an unnamed duty-sheet master and a carbon copy with the same layout.

staff_office_trays.title: Dispatch trays
staff_office_trays.speaker: protagonist
staff_office_trays.text: The OUT tray holds three carbon slips. The IN tray holds only its red label. Someone has turned that tray a little so the two labels no longer line up.
staff_office_trays.repeat_text: Three slips in OUT. The other tray is empty.

staff_office_keys.title: Key rail
staff_office_keys.speaker: protagonist
staff_office_keys.text: Six numbered hooks. Number four has no key or tag. The wood below it is the same colour as the wood around it; there is no outline to tell what hung there.

record.text: Hook four on the office rail is empty; there is no room name on it.
